result.topic_en: Riemann concludes the case of motion of a fluid ellipsoid with rotation about a principal axis, then sets up a Lagrangian-type formulation (point of mass 1 on the surface abc=const with potential function) to derive the equilibrium/motion equations and discusses stability via the variation of a function G, which is maximal for the sphere.
